title: The inverse image of the direct image of a constant sheaf of sets on a closed subset is the direct image of the constant sheaf on the preimage
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a continuous map of topological spaces, $W\subseteq Y$ a closed subset, $Z=f^{-1}(W)$ (closed in $X$) and $R$ a set. For a closed subset $C$ of a topological space $T$ with inclusion $i_C$ let $(i_C)_*\underline R_C$ be the sheaf of sets $V\mapsto\{$locally constant maps $V\cap C\to R\}$ on $T$ (restriction of maps as restriction maps). Put $\mathcal A=(i_W)_*\underline R_W$ on $Y$ and $\mathcal B=(i_Z)_*\underline R_Z$ on $X$, and let $f_*\mathcal B$ be the direct image, $f_*\mathcal B(V)=\mathcal B(f^{-1}V)$. The maps $\alpha_V:\mathcal A(V)\to\mathcal B(f^{-1}V)$, $g\mapsto g\circ f|_{f^{-1}(V)\cap Z}$ ($V\subseteq Y$ open; well defined since $f(f^{-1}(V)\cap Z)\subseteq V\cap W$ and a locally constant map composed with a continuous map is locally constant) form a morphism of sheaves $\alpha:\mathcal A\to f_*\mathcal B$. Let $f^{-1}$ be the inverse image of sheaves of sets with the unit $\eta_{\mathcal A}:\mathcal A\to f_*f^{-1}\mathcal A$ of the adjunction $f^{-1}\dashv f_*$, as in [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image] (2), (3) with values in sets (the adjunction for sheaves of sets is [lem-weil-pbc-sets-inverse-image-colimits-finite-products] (a)), and let $\alpha^\flat:f^{-1}\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be the morphism corresponding to $\alpha$, i.e. the unique morphism of sheaves of sets with $\alpha^\flat_{f^{-1}V}\circ\eta_{\mathcal A,V}=\alpha_V$ for every open $V\subseteq Y$. Then $\alpha^\flat$ is an isomorphism of sheaves of sets on $X$; in particular it is bijective on sections over every open subset of $X$.
